evidence.detail: preaggregate_card_person() builds _card_person_stats table with per-person wins/losses/draws/num_decks per card — data infrastructure already exists
card.mustache shows stats and a deck table but has no section for top players by play count or win rate
Card view does not load or expose person stats to the template

triage.fix_sketch: Add a function in decksite/data/card.py to query _card_person_stats for a given card name, returning top N players by num_decks and win_percent (joining to person table for name). Load this in decksite/views/card.py and attach to the view. Add a new mustache section in decksite/templates/card.mustache showing a small table of top players (played most) and top players (highest win %). All within ~60 lines, no schema changes needed.
triage.notes: The preaggregate infrastructure already supports this; it is purely a read-side feature addition with no schema or data changes.
